description: (Na)₂CuBiCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a CuBiCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the CuBiCl₆ framework, Cu is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form CuCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cu-Cl bond lengths are 2.48 Å. Bi is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form BiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CuCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Bi-Cl bond lengths are 2.71 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Cu and one Bi atom.
